target_game: fantasy RPG with a Three.js/Vite renderer
poly_target: 600-2500 triangles MINIMUM — pistol MUST have body, rail, barrel, grip, guard, hammer as distinct named meshes. Below 300 triangles is UNACCEPTABLE regardless of score.
material_style: teal/jade metallic body (roughness 0.18-0.28, metalness 0.55-0.70), gold ornamental rail+spines (roughness 0.08-0.16, metalness 0.88-1.0), green scale grip (roughness 0.30-0.45, metalness 0.05-0.15), orange guard (roughness 0.12-0.20, metalness 0.65-0.80)
size_reference: asset should fit inside a 2x2x2 unit bounding box; barrel points along +X axis, grip hangs below (-Y). Measured aspect ratio W:H = 1.54:1.

geometry_spec.description: Precise 3D coordinates measured from reference image (1080x702px gun region, mapped to 2.0x1.30 unit space)

rail.note: thin gold strip on TOP of body — separate mesh name='rail'

barrel.note: SHORT FAT STUB — NOT a long rod. 0.22 units long only. CylinderGeometry rotated to X axis.

guard.note: LARGE visible orange bar — minimum 0.40 wide. Ideally a TorusGeometry arc but box acceptable.

hammer.note: small rear sight block at top-rear of body

technique_notes: ORIENTATION: barrel points along +X axis. Grip hangs below along -Y. Gun centred near (0, 0.2, 0). Do NOT use group.rotation.
BODY mesh (name='body'): 1.56x0.42x0.44 BoxGeometry at position (0, 0.28, 0). Subdivide 4x3x3. Vivid teal/jade vertex colors (#4a9070 to #60b090). roughness=0.22, metalness=0.60.

RAIL mesh (name='rail'): SEPARATE thin strip 1.58x0.10x0.46 sitting ON TOP of body at (0, 0.54, 0). Gold vertex color (#c8a030 to #e0b840). roughness=0.10, metalness=0.90. This is the ornamental gold top rail.

BARREL mesh (name='barrel'): CylinderGeometry(0.14, 0.14, 0.22, 10) — SHORT FAT stub, 0.22 units long. rotateZ(PI/2) to align along X. Position (0.89, 0.34, 0). Darker grey-teal (#48606a). roughness=0.25, metalness=0.60. CRITICAL: barrel is SHORT (0.22 long), NOT a long rod.

GRIP mesh (name='grip'): BoxGeometry(0.50, 0.64, 0.43, 3, 8, 3) at (-0.28, -0.22, 0), tilted rotateZ(-PI/12). GREEN DOMINANT scale colours: 70% of faces must be teal-green (#4a7050 to #60a070), with only 15-20% purple/blue accent. CRITICAL: grip mean colour must be GREEN (hue 100-200 degrees), NOT purple.

GUARD mesh (name='guard'): LARGE orange arc/box at (-0.06, -0.20, 0), minimum 0.40 units wide, clearly visible orange (#cc6820 to #e07830). roughness=0.15, metalness=0.70. This is one of the most visible features — make it big and orange.
HAMMER mesh (name='hammer'): small 0.12x0.10x0.44 block at (-0.69, 0.54, 0) — rear sight at top-rear of body. Dark teal (#3a6050).
SPINES: 4-6 small ConeGeometry pyramids (radius 0.05, height 0.08, 4 sides) spaced along the rail top at y=0.64. Gold colour matching rail.

Vertex colors per face: compute from face centroid hash for subtle variation within each part. Use toNonIndexed() + computeVertexNormals() for flat faceted look. Hash MUST return [0,1]: normalise with (h/3+1)*0.5.

Apply posNoise(x,y,z) displacement to each indexed geometry BEFORE toNonIndexed(). This ensures UV-seam vertex pairs at the same position receive identical displacements, fixing shared_edge_fraction. Scale 0.02-0.04.
All materials: MeshStandardMaterial with vertexColors=true, color=0xffffff. Set roughness and metalness explicitly per part.

camera_basis.world_x: image right — barrel tip points right (+X)
camera_basis.world_y: image up — grip hangs below (-Y), spikes point up (+Y)
camera_basis.world_z: image depth — positive Z goes INTO the screen (away from camera)

derived_rules: Barrel along +X axis — gun shows as side profile from quarter-angle camera
Grip below body — gun sits upright, grip at bottom
No group.rotation — geometry already in correct orientation

expected_arrangement.description: single pistol weapon — one body mesh centred near origin

feature_checklist.orange_guard: Is there a visible orange, amber, copper, or brownish-orange trigger guard element located between the main body and the grip of the pistol? It may appear dark due to lighting but should have warm orange/amber hue.
feature_checklist.gold_rail_top: Is there a gold, yellow, or dark-gold ornamental rail or strip along the top of the pistol? It may have small spike-like or pyramidal decorative features on top — these may appear dark due to lighting.
feature_checklist.teal_body: Is the main body/slide of the pistol clearly TEAL, JADE GREEN, or blue-green in colour (not olive-brown or grey)?
feature_checklist.distinct_parts: Are there at least 4 visually distinct parts visible — a horizontal body, a grip hanging below, a barrel at the front, and a guard or trigger element?
feature_checklist.short_barrel_stub: Is the barrel a SHORT STUBBY cylinder at the front (not a long rod extending far beyond the body — it should protrude less than 20% of the total gun length)?

count_and_identity.notes: The image depicts a single decorative gun

shape_and_proportions.silhouette_description: The silhouette is primarily composed of a long, horizontal body with a shorter, curved handle extending downwards and a protruding cylindrical component near the front
